info.name: Rewaa Platform API Collection (Complete)
info.description:
Comprehensive, production-ready Postman API collection for the complete Rewaa Learning Management Platform (Laravel 12 + Sanctum).

### Modules Covered (228 Registered Routes):
1. **General & Public APIs**: Public utilities (countries, FAQs, geocode, static pages, and /api/user lookup).
2. **Website & Student Portal (28 routes)**: Student authentication, available courses, enrolled courses, lessons, exam attempts, orders, payment accounts, profile & wallet.
3. **Provider Dashboard (151 routes)**: Full provider back-office spanning Courses, Lessons, Exams, Question Bank, Templates, Activation Codes, Students, Orders, Financials, Platform Settings, Teachers & Roles.
4. **Super Admin Dashboard (44 routes)**: Platform Super Admin operations spanning Admins, Providers, Educational Stages, Subjects, Countries, Governorates, System Roles & Permissions, and Admin Profile.

### Pre-configured Features:
- Automated Sanctum token extraction into `{{student_token}}`, `{{provider_token}}`, and `{{admin_token}}` upon login.
- Auto-attached Bearer Token per module scope.
- Pre-request localization headers (`X-Locale: {{locale}}`, `Accept-Language: {{locale}}`).
- Complete sample request bodies and query parameters with realistic test values.
- Fully configured path variables with standard fallback identifiers.
